text:
```artifact
Statechart for Alarm System Test Suite

Initial State: System Idle
State: Battery Failure Alarm Active
State: Blower Motor Temperature Alarm Active
State: Blower Power Management System Temperature Alarm Active
State: Battery Temperature Alarm Active

Events:
- Battery Failure Detected
- Blower Motor Temperature Exceeded Threshold
- Blower Power Management System Temperature Exceeded Threshold
- Battery Temperature Exceeded Threshold
- Safety Action Invoked

Guards:
- Battery Failure Priority High
- Blower Motor Temperature Threshold Exceeded
- Blower Power Management System Temperature Threshold Exceeded
- Battery Temperature Threshold Exceeded

Transitions:
- From System Idle to Battery Failure Alarm Active when Battery Failure Detected
- From System Idle to Blower Motor Temperature Alarm Active when Blower Motor Temperature Exceeded Threshold
- From System Idle to Blower Power Management System Temperature Alarm Active when Blower Power Management System Temperature Exceeded Threshold
- From System Idle to Battery Temperature Alarm Active when Battery Temperature Exceeded Threshold
- From any Alarm Active State to Safety Action Invoked when Temperature Exceeded Threshold

Lifecycle:
- System Idle -> Battery Failure Alarm Active -> System Idle
- System Idle -> Blower Motor Temperature Alarm Active -> System Idle
- System Idle -> Blower Power Management System Temperature Alarm Active -> System Idle
- System Idle -> Battery Temperature Alarm Active -> System Idle

Mode-Switching Behaviour:
- System Idle -> Battery Failure Alarm Active (High Priority)
- System Idle -> Blower Motor Temperature Alarm Active (Normal Priority)
- System Idle -> Blower Power Management System Temperature Alarm Active (Normal Priority)
- System Idle -> Battery Temperature Alarm Active (Normal Priority)

Test Suite:

1. Test Case: Battery Failure Alarm Triggered
   Preconditions: System Idle
   Inputs: Battery Failure Detected
   Steps: Transition to Battery Failure Alarm Active
   Expected: Battery Failure Alarm Active

2. Test Case: Blower Motor Temperature Alarm Triggered
   Preconditions: System Idle
   Inputs: Blower Motor Temperature Exceeded Threshold
   Steps: Transition to Blower Motor Temperature Alarm Active
   Expected: Blower Motor Temperature Alarm Active

3. Test Case: Blower Power Management System Temperature Alarm Triggered
   Preconditions: System Idle
   Inputs: Blower Power Management System Temperature Exceeded Threshold
   Steps: Transition to Blower Power Management System Temperature Alarm Active
   Expected: Blower Power Management System Temperature Alarm Active

4. Test Case: Battery Temperature Alarm Triggered
   Preconditions: System Idle
   Inputs: Battery Temperature Exceeded Threshold
   Steps: Transition to Battery Temperature Alarm Active
   Expected: Battery Temperature Alarm Active

5. Test Case: Safety Action Invoked for Blower Motor Temperature
   Preconditions: Blower Motor Temperature Alarm Active
   Inputs: Temperature Exceeded Threshold
   Steps: Transition to Safety Action Invoked
   Expected: Safety Action Invoked

6. Test Case: Safety Action Invoked for Blower Power Management System Temperature
   Preconditions: Blower Power Management System Temperature Alarm Active
   Inputs: Temperature Exceeded Threshold
   Steps: Transition to Safety Action Invoked
   Expected: Safety Action Invoked

7. Test Case: Safety Action Invoked for Battery Temperature
   Preconditions: Battery Temperature Alarm Active
   Inputs: Temperature Exceeded Threshold
   Steps: Transition to Safety Action Invoked
   Expected: Safety Action Invoked

```
